root_cause.text: The `ssif_probe` function in the IPMI SSIF driver fails to stop and clean up the newly created `ssif_info->thread` kthread if an error occurs during initialization before the interface is successfully registered.
root_cause.evidence: The patch adds an error handling block in `ssif_probe` under the `out:` label to check if `ssif_info->thread` is active and stop it using `kthread_stop(ssif_info->thread)` when `rv` is non-zero.
